$comment: The hand-off of a task to an office — the record make-a-task.js points at when it says who the task is handed to belongs to the dispatch, never to the record. A dispatch names a task and the office it is handed to, and nothing else of substance: the task carries the goal, the duty carries the obligation, the office carries the answering-for, and the dispatch is only the fact that these were joined. It is handed to an office, never to a person, for the charter's reason exactly: handed to a person it dies with the person. A dispatch is open while the task's goal is unachieved, and openness is a readout, never a field — re-run the goal (make-a-task.js --verify) and the board is the truth. One task, one dispatch: a second dispatch of the same task would be two offices answering for one goal, which is a contradiction to name, not a queue to append to.

name.$comment: What the hand-off is called, as it is said: 'the glossary index task, to the content librarian'.

task.$comment: The task handed over. Names a task and must resolve to a seated one: a dispatch of a task that seats nowhere hands an office nothing and leaves it answering for it anyway.

office.$comment: The office the task is handed to. Names an office and must resolve to one — never a person, or the hand-off dies with the person; never a session, or it dies with the context window.

$comment-absences: No status, no open or closed key: openness is derived by re-running the dispatched task's goal, and a dispatch that could assert its own closure would be the worker marking the board instead of the goal marking it. No accepted or acknowledged key: an office bears what its position hands it, and acceptance theater on the record would let a dispatch sit unowned while looking owned. No priority and no queue position: the pool is a board, not a queue, and ordering the work is the incumbent's judgment at the board, not the dispatcher's assertion in the record. No deadline: the allocation and the next checkpoint bound the time, per the charter's rule. No dispatcher beyond provenance: who joined task to office is history, recorded where history is recorded.
